name: Revenue Booster for WooCommerce
author: Dotstore

sections.description:
Boost your WooCommerce store’s revenue effortlessly with the Revenue Booster for WooCommerce plugin. This tool allows you to increase your average order value by implementing tried-and-tested techniques that enhance customer buying behavior. By presenting options like “frequently bought together” items, customers can easily add complementary products, making their shopping experience more engaging and fulfilling.

The “order bumps” feature provides an additional layer of sales potential, allowing you to suggest relevant products during the checkout process. This gentle nudge encourages customers to consider other items they may not have initially thought of, often leading to higher cart values. Order bumps can be highly effective, offering products that align with customers’ main purchases.

Ultimately, the WooCommerce Revenue Booster plugin is a smart investment for online retailers looking to optimize sales without overhauling their entire store. Simple yet powerful, it enables increased profitability by leveraging customer psychology and creating more opportunities for upsells.

With Revenue Booster for WooCommerce, you get:

  • The Right Strategy to Increase Your Sales
  • Post-Cart Frequently Bought Together
  • Order Bump at Checkout
  • Post-Purchase Cross Sell After The Checkout
  • World-class, responsive, and fast customer support

sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

  1. Upload the folder revenue-booster-for-woocommerce to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
How does Revenue Booster for WooCommerce work?

Revenue Booster for WooCommerce plugin works in the same way as every other plugin for WordPress. Just download, install, and activate it on your WooCommerce store with basic settings and you are all set.

In the frequently bought together list, is it possible to hide the main product?

No, it is not possible to remove the main product from the list.

How can I ask for support with my Revenue Booster for Woocommerce plugin?

The customer support team for Revenue Booster or for any plugin is available round-the-clock. You can get support by going to support page.

Can I upgrade my Revenue Booster plugin after the download was made?

After download the free revenue booster plugin, you can further upgrade it to the premium plan in the future. Currently this Revenue Booster plugin offers free version only.
